caption: A rich, golden miso ramen broth fills a black bowl, topped with tender chashu pork, shredded cabbage, and vibrant green scallions. The warm lighting highlights the glossy broth and neatly arranged toppings against a wooden table.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections, forming an oval-shaped area around the bowl.
Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced, pinkish-brown meat with visible fat marbling and slight char, resting atop noodles.
The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and viscous, with visible noodles and toppings partially submerged.
Black ceramic bowl with glossy finish, smooth curved rim, and subtle speckled texture visible along its inner edge.
